newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungary's forint leaves NBH bid on forex buying.
newsitem.headline: Hungary's forint leaves NBH bid on forex buying.

text.p: Hungary's forint opened firmer against the dollar but some 30 to 35 pips weaker than the central bank's bid due to foreign currency buying, traders said.
"The main reason behind it (the forint's weakening) is the settlement of futures and options today," said Friedrich Brandt of Commerzbank.
At 0831 GMT, the forint stood at 180.50/60 against the dollar compared with Tuesday's close of 181.02/07.
Currency futures mature on May 21 on both the Budapest Stock Exchange and the Budapest Commodity Exchange.
(NBH basket: 30 percent dollar + 70 percent mark. The NBH's intervention range is 4.5 percent wide.)
